title: Contracts Core
description: Deterministic Foundry mapping for BlackCat contracts.

tests.title: BlackCat Foundry suite passes under forge test output mapping.
tests.description: This test validates the BlackCat contract behavior using the existing Foundry suite and writes deterministic mapped results. It catches on-chain logic regressions.
steps: Run forge test --json in contracts package
tests.successCriteria: BlackCat.t.sol passes and deterministic mapping artifact is produced.

tests.title: Contract test execution is stable across repeated forge runs with unchanged state.
tests.description: This deep contract test checks repeatability of the Foundry suite by requiring consistent pass behavior on repeated execution. It catches flaky tests and hidden order dependencies.
steps: Run forge test --json once and capture result
Run forge test --json again without code changes
Confirm both runs produce consistent pass/fail outcome
tests.successCriteria: Repeated forge runs remain consistent and deterministic for mapped suites.
